nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the quiz question; writable by StartGame and NewQuestion and readable by anyone.
Private address state variable storing the account that created the question; used as the only access-control guard for StopGame and NewQuestion.
Public boolean state variable, initially false, set to true by GiftHasBeenSent to mark the game as finished; gates the payout branch in Play.
Bytes32 state variable holding the keccak256 hash of the expected answer, compared against keccak256(_response) in Play.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller address used for authorization checks, ownership assignment and as the recipient of ether transfers.
tx.origin: the original transaction signer, compared against msg.sender in Play as a weak anti-contract guard.

External payable Play(string _response): verifies msg.sender == tx.origin, checks the answer hash, the msg.value threshold and the closed flag, then transfers the whole contract balance to msg.sender and closes the game.
Public payable StartGame(string _question, string _response): stores the answer hash, the question text and records msg.sender as questionSender.
Public payable StopGame(): requires msg.sender == questionSender, marks the game closed and transfers the contract balance to the caller if msg.value > 0.01 ether.
Public payable NewQuestion(string _question, bytes32 _responseHash): restricted to questionSender, overwrites the question and the response hash without any state-progress restriction.
Private GiftHasBeenSent(): internal helper that flips the closed flag to true.
Unnamed payable fallback function that accepts plain ether transfers with no logic.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) in Play: full-balance external value transfer to the untrusted caller before any post-transfer bookkeeping, executed while state is not fully finalized.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) in StopGame: full-balance external value transfer to the caller after GiftHasBeenSent, reachable by the question owner under a weak guard.
Parameter _response of Play, hashed and compared against responseHash.
Parameter _question of StartGame, stored into the question state variable.
Parameter _response of StartGame, hashed with keccak256 and stored into responseHash.
Parameter _question of NewQuestion, stored into the question state variable.
Parameter _responseHash of NewQuestion, written directly into the responseHash state variable.

edges.reason: _response in Play is hashed with keccak256 and compared against the responseHash state variable.
_response in StartGame is hashed with keccak256 and written into responseHash.
_question in StartGame is written into the public question state variable.
_question in NewQuestion overwrites the question state variable.
_responseHash in NewQuestion is written directly into responseHash.
msg.sender is stored as questionSender in StartGame, letting any caller claim ownership of the game.
msg.sender is compared against tx.origin via require in Play, forming the access-control gate.
tx.origin participates in the require(msg.sender == tx.origin) guard in Play.
Play reaches msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) after a hash/threshold check, performing an external call to an untrusted address.
msg.sender is the recipient of the full-balance transfer, so the attacker-controlled address receives value during Play.
Play invokes the private GiftHasBeenSent helper after the payout.
GiftHasBeenSent sets the closed state variable to true.
Play indirectly mutates the closed flag through GiftHasBeenSent, altering the payout branch condition.
Play reads the closed state variable as part of its payout condition.
Play reads responseHash to compare it against keccak256(_response).
StopGame relies on questionSender for the require(msg.sender == questionSender) authorization check.
msg.sender must equal questionSender to pass the StopGame guard, so the caller identity controls execution flow.
StopGame reaches msg.sender.transfer(this.balance), an external call with the full contract balance.
msg.sender is the value recipient of the StopGame transfer, allowing an untrusted address to receive all funds.
StopGame calls GiftHasBeenSent before performing the value transfer, closing the game.
NewQuestion guards question overwrite with require(msg.sender == questionSender).
msg.sender determines whether the NewQuestion state overwrite is permitted.

_question is a parameter used exclusively inside StartGame to initialize the question state.
_response is a parameter used exclusively inside StartGame to initialize responseHash.
_question is a parameter used exclusively inside NewQuestion to overwrite the question state.
_responseHash is a parameter used exclusively inside NewQuestion to overwrite responseHash.
